# اُعْتُكِدَا (uʕtukidā) /uʕ.tu.ki.daː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
# اِعْتَكِدَا (iʕtakidā) /iʕ.ta.ki.daː/: second-person dual imperative of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
